title: carpinus betulus var. typica
intro: Carpinus betulus var. typica, commonly known as the European hornbeam, is a deciduous tree species native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of Carpinus betulus var. typica include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and sedative properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The health benefits of this plant are also associated with its ability to improve cardiovascular health and reduce oxidative stress, making it a valuable natural remedy for various health conditions.
